names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9361, «Неофит (Любимов), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; протоиерей is the archpriest, a rank the day line does not give him — it has only «Неофита … пресвитера». The surname is the index's.

death.note: The Russian day line, which gives one year for all four of the day's martyrs of that year: «Сщмчч. Неофита и Анатолия пресвитеров, прмчч. Иакинфа и Каллиста (1918)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Неофита и Анатолия пресвитеров, прмчч. Иакинфа и Каллиста (1918).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day's two icons stand in the paragraph above this one, before Hosea and before Andrew of Crete.

attestations.note: **The line enumerates four and so it is four folders.** It names two presbyters, Neophytus and Anatolius, and two monk-martyrs, Hyacinth and Callistus, all of 1918; the calendar's index of names supplies the four surnames and nothing else. His own page, 9361, calls him «протоиерей», archpriest, where the day line has only presbyter, and gives the second day he is kept on, «26 января (Новомуч.)»; the January day was not read. **There is no life anywhere**: no life link on the day line and none on the name page. azbyka.ru, the workable source for the twentieth-century new martyrs, answered **403** to the corpus's own fetcher on 28 October 2026 and was not asked again.
